description: A block of type dynamic is expanded even when the schema requests that type
notes: The README makes dynamic a special block type, but doesn't say what happens when a schema requests blocks of that type itself, which could then be read as ordinary blocks. hashicorp/hcl treats every block of type dynamic that the body gives as a dynamic block, whatever the schema requests (expandBody.expandBlocks in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go), so it expands this one and reports the block type b, which the schema doesn't request.
reference_error: Blocks of type "b" are not expected here
